This document is a README-style overview of "Project Maya," a tool for running large MoE language models locally. Key technical points:

**Models supported:** Three main families — GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash — each offered in multiple quantized variants (Maya-XS, Maya-S, Maya-S24, Maya-M, Maya-L, plus "Derisked" versions).
